title: people.json
description: Registry of the people a visual or a copy may show or name (founders, team, customers quoted on camera), written by the project-context agent to <project>/project-context/people.json and read through shared/scripts/registry.py. A person appears in a deliverable only when consent.status is granted and consent.scope covers the use (ads for the static-ads-builder photo edit mode), or when is_operator is true. A person absent from the file is treated as consent unknown: blocked. Every path is relative to the project-context/ folder. Validate with: python3 shared/scripts/validate_json.py shared/schemas/people.schema.json <people.json>, then python3 shared/scripts/registry.py check <project-context> for the rules a schema cannot hold.

name.description: Name as the person writes it.

role.description: Role shown next to the name, e.g. Founder, Head of design, Customer at Acme.

photo.description: Portrait under assets/people/. Stored only once consent is granted, or for the operator.

is_operator.description: true for the founder who runs the agents: their own name and photo need no recorded consent.

scope.description: Uses covered. A granted consent needs at least one.

date.description: Day the consent was given or refused.

source.description: Where it is recorded: 'email of 2026-10-02', 'signed release form', 'reply on the call of 2026-09-14'.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the project-context/ folder. Never absolute, never starting with project-context/, never climbing with '..'.
